guides.title: Search the archive and create a collection
guides.summary: Find indexed media and group selected assets without moving source files.
prerequisites: Archive and Collections must be enabled.
Sign in with permission to manage collections.
The archive must contain indexed media.

steps.title: Search media
steps.instruction: Enter Ridge Sunrise.mp4 in Search media and submit the search.
steps.expected: The exact indexed synthetic clip appears in the results.

steps.title: Select and create
steps.instruction: Select Ridge Sunrise.mp4, choose Add to collection, name the collection ARCHIVE-DOCS-SELECTS, add the synthetic-review note, and choose Create and add.
steps.expected: Media Nexus confirms that the collection was created.

steps.title: Verify membership
steps.instruction: Open Collections, open ARCHIVE-DOCS-SELECTS, and verify that Ridge Sunrise.mp4 is a member.
steps.expected: The collection contains the selected clip; its source path has not changed.

expected: The selected media appears in ARCHIVE-DOCS-SELECTS without moving the synthetic source file.
recovery: If the catalog cannot load, choose Retry catalog and repeat the exact filename search.
If Create and add is disabled, enter a nonempty collection name and confirm that the account has collection-management permission.
review: Runtime acceptance must confirm every selector and expected result against the exact served Core revision before this draft can enter Portal review.
